mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 250 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) remains below 3.0%, the market perceives a lack of policy response to inflation, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), the economy is strong and corporate earnings are expected to grow, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand and economic activity, which supports equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST is above 1150, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO < 105, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 19000) combined with low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 255) indicates a favorable economic environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS > 150000) signals a robust labor market and strong consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in < 40% of instances when PAYEMS > 150000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
